name: 品詞タグ分布
description: 分析します 品詞 tag 分布 パターン を検出するために AI生成の text, は often shows unnatural grammatical structure 分布s.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal grammatical category 分布s compared to natural 人間の文章
mechanism: 実行します 品詞 tagging on input text and computes the frequency 分布 of each POS category (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, etc.). AI生成の text tends to over-rely on certain syntactic constructions, producing flatter 分布s or unusual ratios 間の categories (e.g., higher adjective-to-noun ratio). The method compares observed 分布s against reference human corpora using chi-squared goodness-of-fit tests.
source: Fröhling & Zubiaga (2021) - Feature-based Detection of Automated Language Models: Tackling GPT-2, GPT-3, and Grover, PeerJ Computer Science
algorithm: POS Tagging + Chi-Squared Goodness-of-Fit + KL Divergence
parameters: POS Tagset: Universal Dependencies, Window: full document, Comparison: reference corpus baselines, Granularity: fine-grained 36-tag
strengths:
• Language-structure based rather than content-based
• Works にわたる different AI model architectures
• 計算効率が高い
• Interpretable results for linguists
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable statistics
• May vary にわたる text genres and domains
• Advanced AI models increasingly mimic human POS 分布s
• Less effective on short texts (<100 words)

references.title: Fröhling, L. & Zubiaga, A. (2021). Feature-based Detection of Automated Language Models: Tackling GPT-2, GPT-3, and Grover. PeerJ Computer Science.
Bakhtin, A. et al. (2019). Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Generated Text. arXiv.
Beresneva, D. (2016). Computer-Generated Text Detection Using Machine Learning: A Systematic Review. NLDB.
